title: Eric Ries - NYT Bestselling Author of Incorruptible
text:
Eric Ries - NYT Bestselling Author of Incorruptible
- The Lean Start-Up by Eric Ries is a classic business book that has inspired a generation of entrepreneurs around the world. I've met many of them, working as a business journalist in the UK. It's a very practical book that promotes ideas like Validated Learning and Small Batch Testing. We're welcoming Eric Ries on the Business Leader podcast next month. Revisiting the book reminded me of one entrepreneur in particular I'd encountered who seemed to exemplify the methods the book extols. Read [...] - Eric Ries ’ first book, Lean Startup, changed my life in a big way - it was the foundation of what we taught hundreds and thousands of Technovation students around the world to take big problems and quickly build, measure, learn - repeat - and build real startups that did big things! Now his second book, Incorruptible, is just what the world needs right now. A bright light that says each of our actions makes a difference - yes even on the big, important financial markets. And we can make a [...] And we can make a lot of money - AND - help humans flourish. His idea is really simple - spend some time finding something that is worth fighting for, worth protecting. That is your mission. Build your organization around those values in such a coherent way that almost every decision you make is guided by the mission.
